OH. Oh no. ...The gamblers are very quiet.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Mabel Nowak is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Mabel Nowak is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Mabel kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
"Mabel's gone." Catalina looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Mabel." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Nathan blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Scrounger (Level 1). Ruin looting finds +1 item.
📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
📖 LEARNED: Reading the Land (Level 1). Eat the landscape with your eyes first: green + water + sun means food grows here. Start where those three meet.
📖 LEARNED: The Forager’s Eye (Level 1). You walk slower and see more. Food was always there; now you notice it.
📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
"OH! OH! PRECISE MEND! The audience did NOT see that coming! Knowledge AMPLIFIES power! The gamblers are recalculating EVERYTHING!"
📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
📖 LEARNED: Stalk (Level 1). Move unseen. Close distance without being noticed.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Mabel Nowak, 50 days. The mantle passes to Nathan Villa.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Nathan Villa, 65 — a Wild food forager. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Bird Whisperer, Green Whisper, Echo Location.
The village's quarrel was with Mabel — and Mabel is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
You knew Mabel — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting them, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
At the grave, Jenny, Yesenia, Bianca and 5 more speak for Nathan — "Mabel trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew Nathan before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
